Priya: Anyone seen the node sample-app start spitting interleaved tokens after auth refresh during long SSE streams? Repro on Chrome and mobile web behind our proxy.
Sam: Hmm — not exactly that wording, but I remember a similar production incident. Do you have logs + which SDK (node/browser) variant the sample app uses?
Priya: Node sample-app uses eventsource-polyfill with our node-sdk wrapper. Logs (snip):
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] INFO  stream-start id=abc123
[2026-03-20T14:13:08Z] WARN  auth-refresh status=401 token=expiring
[2026-03-20T14:13:09Z] INFO  reconnecting new-token
[2026-03-20T14:13:09Z] INFO  chunk-recv data="...partial json \n"
[2026-03-20T14:13:09Z] INFO  chunk-recv data="...continued json\n"
[2026-03-20T14:13:09Z] ERROR parser: unexpected token at position N
```
Repro steps in the sample app: 1) start streaming prompt that runs >65s, 2) let token refresh trigger, 3) watch client logs. Sample app link: https://git.corp/redwood/sample-apps/node-stream-demo (staging branch).
Jorge: Two things to consider: (1) browser EventSource vs our Node parser behave differently on partial frames; (2) some proxies will coalesce or split TCP chunks unpredictably. If a reconnect happens mid-event we need Last-Event-ID semantics or an id-based de-dupe.
Sam: Agree. I think the root is our reconnect sequence: we request a new token, open a new connection, but we don't set Last-Event-ID on the reconnect, so server may re-send an overlapping window and our parser isn't de-duplicating by event id. Also our node-sdk parser will try to parse a partial line as a full event if the socket closes mid-line.
Priya: I tried a quick patch locally to buffer incomplete lines until a full '\n\n' event terminator and to honor an 'id:' field for de-dupe. That fixed the parser errors but I still sometimes see duplicate content in the UI (tokens repeated).
ci-bot: deploy: sample-app/staging build failed: sse-integration-tests (see CI #4321).
Sam: For duplicates we likely need two layers: 1) send Last-Event-ID on reconnect so server can skip already-delivered events, 2) client-side id de-dup as a safety net. Also add logic to treat 401 during stream as 'graceful refresh' path vs abrupt close.
Jorge: Another edge is proxies that change payload boundaries — your buffer fix helps but we should also make the parser tolerant of CRLF/partial CR sequences and avoid throwing on partial JSON. Add robust partial-JSON buffering: collect data until you can parse one event payload, don't assume newline aligns with full JSON.
Priya: Notes for onboarding/sample apps: the quickstart should mention long-lived streams will need token refresh strategies and recommend Last-Event-ID usage or short TTLs for dev tokens. Right now the sample app docs only show the naive eventsource usage. That's part of why folks hit this while onboarding.
Sam: Plan: I'll open PRs: (a) node-sdk: improve SSE parser buffering + id de-dup and Last-Event-ID header on reconnect; (b) sample-app: update quickstart + add e2e that simulates mid-chunk auth refresh; (c) add a small CI test that injects proxy chunk reordering.
Jorge: I'll help with test harness and the proxy simulation. QA-team please add a regression case.
Priya: Thanks — assigning to @Sam and @Jorge. QA-team can follow up in the sample-app issue. If anyone wants the small repro script I used that flips auth at ~65s I can paste it here. :thumbsup:
